notes: Parts 06-10 (50 groups, 53 rows). Merged groups (one row each, per rule 3): Mirendil = mirendil + this startup 2 (WSJ headline); Plural fund = plural + early helsing and proxima; Corma = corma 1b valuation + corma hits 1b three + cybersecurity; Sofinnova fund = sofinnova + sofinnovas graziano seghezzi; Fractile = with 720m round + fractile; Paladin Energy = paladin + t pdn successfully completes a 525; Torus = torus + utah based startup (Bloomberg headline); Agile Robots = softbank led agile robots + softbank leads 500 million + germanys agile robots. Round-ups expanded: weeks 10 biggest funding (Crunchbase News, Nov 7-13, read from the stored text only) -> Path Robotics, LangChain, Nominal, Imprint, Mavria, Delix Therapeutics, Rox as own rows dated to the article day unless a lookup gave the date; its Mirendil, Mercor, Torus and Databento items were folded into those groups' rows. cee startup (The Recursive weekly) -> Biomatter, Kardi AI, Hedepy, Valkyrie Dynamics, Kinderpedia, DeltaGen (acquired by Worker.ai), BlackPeak Capital (fund first close); its UFORCE item was folded into the uforce row; Bitspiration VC (fund still being prepared) and Lexroom (product launch) were skipped. six anz startups that -> only Q-CTRL has figures in the stored text; Alta, Vudoo, Refilled, Provectus Algae and Aimer Farming are named without amounts, so no rows. Two rows for Edelbyte (from stealth to a): $25M seed and $45M Series A announced together as $70M; HQ set to US under the dual-HQ rule (offices in Tel Aviv and San Francisco; one outlet calls it an Israeli startup), worth a human check. Mavria: $130M is the stated pre-seed plus seed total; coverage found by lookup puts the Paradigm-led seed itself at about $100M. Emulate: round is reported by Sifted, not announced; leads come from the fetched MLQ article citing the FT, and the validator may drop them because the source URL is the candidate URL. Positron AI is an award release that recaps its September Series C (not-funding). Twelve is a re-dated blog post about its 2024 $645M financing (not-funding; date set to the post date so the row validates). Private-company debt (Resolven, Stonebriar ABS, Panamint project loan, Peak 10 facility) is kept as Debt/Other with no exclude_reason. Non-USD conversions use about EUR 1.11, GBP 1.35, AUD 0.682. Web lookups used: 8 of 25 (Emulate article fetch; CTech fetch that identified Edelbyte; Edelbyte search; Blocks and Files fetch for Edelbyte; AI-claim searches for Databento, Nominal and Imprint; Mavria search for HQ and date). crunchbase.com was not fetched.
